svg.title: Cold-room temperature and applied compressor command for the selected hysteresis-plus-dwell controller
svg.desc: Simulation evidence: qualified cold-room air temperature against the product band and hysteresis thresholds, requested and applied compressor command, and the retained candidate comparison of quiet-window applied-state transitions for the single-threshold, hysteresis-only, and hysteresis-plus-dwell candidates.
svg.text: Requested (red dashed) and applied (green) compressor command
